meta.note: Brand colours are the official logo's exact values. Neutrals follow the team rule of a warm off-white page and warm near-black text. Status colours were added for plain-word status labels. Contrast ratios in usage notes were computed by hand with the WCAG 2 formula.
meta.handoffNote: Copied from the NaviG8r design system (https://claude.ai/artifact/Y5Y3QwE9ZRBB4XuHLN2YXD) on 2026-10-17. 'additions' are proposed by the mobile redesign and are not yet in the system.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy, from the logo badge. Primary buttons, selected chips, the app bar title, links and the focus ring. White on navy is 15.6:1; navy on page is 14.6:1.

tokens.name: navy-ink
tokens.usage: The wordmark's navy. Headings and screen titles on page and card (about 15:1).

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: The logo badge's darker end. Dark plates behind the light logo and the deepest brand block. Never behind body text on light screens.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brand gold, from the logo pin. Marks, icons and highlights on navy (7.3:1). Never as text or a thin mark on page or card: it is 2.0:1 there.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: The gold of 'G8' in the wordmark. Large brand moments only (the wordmark, the cover). Not for text on light grounds.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: The logo tagline's slate. Secondary text, captions, unselected navigation labels: 5.0:1 on page, 5.4:1 on card, 4.6:1 on sunken.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Warm off-white page background for every screen. Never pure white for a page.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces only: cards, text fields, the bottom navigation bar, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed bands: table header rows, read-only fields, disabled controls.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card and divider borders that only group content. Decorative: it does not meet 3:1 and must never be the only thing that identifies a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control: text fields, secondary buttons, checkboxes. 3.6:1 on page, 3.8:1 on card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on page, card and sunken: 14.0:1 on page, 15.0:1 on card.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a navy fill (15.6:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 14.6:1 on page.

tokens.name: nav-indicator
tokens.usage: Navy at 12%: the pill behind the selected bottom-navigation icon, as the app draws it today.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Text of a good status (Approved, Delivered, Paid): 5.6:1 on good-tint, 6.2:1 on page. Always with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: good-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a good status label.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Text of a status that needs someone to act (Waiting for review, Payment held): 5.7:1 on attention-tint, 6.0:1 on page.

tokens.name: attention-tint
tokens.usage: Background of an attention status label.

tokens.name: problem
tokens.usage: Text and border of a problem status, errors and destructive buttons (Reject): 6.0:1 on problem-tint, 7.1:1 on page, 7.6:1 on card.

tokens.name: problem-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a problem status label and of an inline error message.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a neutral in-progress status label (In transit, Submitted); its text is navy (12.9:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: the ops console page title, marketing headings.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: App screen titles in the app bar (the app's 26px bold today).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bank details received. This carrier is waiting for NaviG8r operations to review it.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names and values that lead a row or card; button labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, timestamps, helper text under fields.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Short uppercase labels above groups, in slate; echoes the logo tagline's spaced capitals.

styles.name: nav-label
styles.usage: Bottom navigation labels (the app's 11px today); selected in navy, others in slate.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: IDs people copy or compare. Money and weights stay in the body face with tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a status label and its row; list item padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Banner padding in the app; gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the side gutter at every width.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Form screen padding in the app.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of a page, marketing section breaks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status labels and small tags.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons (the app's filled and outlined buttons today).

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Text fields (the app's input fields today).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards (the app's cards today).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips and the navigation indicator (the app's chips today).

color.name: scrim
color.usage: Dims the screen under a bottom sheet. White sheet vs dimmed page about 3.0:1. Never behind text.

type.name: id-display
type.usage: E-way bill numbers on the driver check-post screen. navy-ink on card about 15:1.

size.name: target-min
size.usage: Minimum tap target everywhere in the app (system says 44; brief requires 48).

pairing.name: on-good
pairing.usage: Short 'Saved' confirmation on a button, about 6.6:1.

pairing.name: status-ended
pairing.usage: Status labels for Full, Done, Cancelled (14:1). No new colour.
